picks.name: Spellslinger
picks.annotation: Use Puddle Punch (3) to stack it! The fire rate gain and reload speed should make you able to deal with any enemy.

picks.name: Silencer
picks.annotation: Lowers the damage of Spirit heroes by hitting them. Silencing them is also beneficial.

picks.name: Glass Cannon
picks.annotation: A ton more damage with your gun, which also affects Puddle Punch (3).

picks.name: Crushing Fists
picks.annotation: With Rapid Recharge, you can spam Puddle Punch (3) to stack Crushing Fists easily! Resulting in an easy stun and a lot of bullet resistance shredding.

picks.name: Witchmail
picks.annotation: You'll take a lot of Spirit Damage late game, so this will proc a lot, granting you a lot more charges of Puddle Punch (3)!

picks.name: Colossus
picks.annotation: ColoSUS. Very useful when going in to melee. Makes you a lot tankier too.

picks.name: Phantom Strike
picks.annotation: A must pick and top priority if fighting flyers, who you'll have a hard time punching. So bring them down using this!

picks.name: Indomitable
picks.annotation: Basically an Automatic Counterspell against CC. Works against Cursed Relic. If facing many CC, buy Unstoppable. Very useful against Lash's Ult, Vyper's Ult, Bebop's Hook, Doorman's Ult and much more!

picks.name: Mystic Reverb
picks.annotation: Extra burst potential, along with a strong slow and lifesteal when using Splatter (1).

picks.name: Spirit Burn
picks.annotation: Anti-Healing and Extra Burst. Easily triggered by your burst damage. |Replaces Healbane in Late Game|

picks.name: Scourge
picks.annotation: Very efficient when going in! And makes you survive more against Spirit oriented enemies.

picks.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
picks.annotation: Splatter (1), Mystic Shot and Spirit Snatch will trigger this. Allowing you to deal more damage with your melee or gun. |Can be sold for a slot|

picks.name: Ballistic Enchantment
picks.annotation: Way bigger Puddle Punch (3), which makes it even more of a threat during teamfights.

picks.name: Hunter's Aura
picks.annotation: More shredding to get the upperhand during fights, especially at close range.

picks.name: Point Blank
picks.annotation: More damage for Puddle Punch (3)! You don't need to be close for it to work with Puddle Punch (3)!

picks.name: Crippling Headshot
picks.annotation: If you want to help your team deal more damage, while also reducing the enemy's healing. This works great against Victor!
